title: CN/V20261019 whole-hand subset shuffle to deck bottom
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 SHA256 27bda43d8cb78ed800891c6793e5efd945ac64d94a83ceff8adaed10e8f67419: II.E-19 FAQ2 PDF p63 (Marnie), II.E-35 PDF pp73–74 (Marnie/Greedent), one-based. effects.hand-bottom is not E-36 full-deck shuffle. No card approval, RNG receipt, use permission or player-view payload is issued here.

action.description: Use the actual source.owner, never current. Target each whole hand without looking at definitions. The host separately checks declaration eligibility after excluding the played Trainer and costs; this pure planner receives the true committed context.

window.description: PRIVATE original IDs. hand preserves original order; deck is bottom first. The runtime also checks disjointness and physical identity/owner in the actual context. An untrusted window is not self-authenticating.

windows.description: One window for own/opponent; both includes both windows, including empty ones, in actual-user-first serialization order. This is not a simultaneous-trigger priority.

plan.description: PRIVATE detached plan, not a permission or public event. At least one nonempty hand, including a singleton, means performed. Empty hands do not count even if their decks are nonempty. The host shuffles separate copies privately, clears each hand, and prepends that shuffled bottom-first hand to its unchanged original deck; never reshuffle the old deck or expose the resulting order.
